messages.subject: Coord_equal coord_fixed and axis labels
parts:
G'day,

As a new user to ggplto2 I was wondering if anyone had a fix for the
change, or lack of change in position of axis labels when setting the
aspect ratio of a graph using the coord_equal or coord_fixed
function? For an example see the coord_equal page on the ggplot2
website. When the aspect ratio is changed, the axis labels stay put.
Is there a way, perhaps by ordering of the commands, that will move
the axis label into the correct position? I am giving a seminar on
data graphics and wanted to point out the role aspect ratio plays in
interpreting data. So I want to modify existing plots rather than
redrawing them all over again

Regards


John Walker

messages.author: 99a1cfc66539313c
messages.subject: Re: Coord_equal coord_fixed and axis labels
parts:
John

After played around with a kludgey solution to your problem using
coord_equal(), it struck me that you may be framing the question
incorrectly. You say you want to illustrate the effect of different
aspect ratios. Surely the easiest way to demonstrate this is to
change the aspect ratio of the graphics device? Here is some really
simple code to do this.

Health warning: As far as I know, the windows() command will only work
in the M$ Windows operating system. If this doesn't work, plot the
graph, and manually change the plot window size. The graph will
reshape to the new window dimensions. Then copy and paste your
graph. Alternatively, use ggsave to save the graph to a specific
size.

windows(4,3)
qplot(mpg, wt, data = mtcars)

windows(8,3)
qplot(mpg, wt, data = mtcars)

windows(3,8)
qplot(mpg, wt, data = mtcars)

Andrie
